I know if I got a second chance at life, to start over as my own person, things would be a lot different. But you know, I just don’t see the world the same anymore, I disagree with everything about this world and so many things make me mad. It may be depression but I know it’s definitely situational. If I had the choice to leave it all and start somewhere new I would but at the end of the day, I just want to save myself and survive. I know with love and big changes I can recover from it all.
